long_biography.plain_text:
Flying Partners began with Bernard Van Milders managing an aircraft shared by several owners. He added charter services through Flying Service and secured operating and maintenance approvals. In 2001, those activities were brought together as FLYINGGROUP, creating an integrated platform for managing aircraft on behalf of clients.

From Antwerp, the group extended its business to France, the Netherlands, Luxembourg and other European and Middle Eastern bases. Its services span charter brokerage, flight operations, crew management, maintenance, certification and ground handling. Van Milders continues to provide founder-level leadership, while the enterprise's professional management teams oversee the operating companies and client aircraft.
